# Henry County Consulting

> Paid, do-it-with-you workflow and agent consulting in Clinton, Henry County, Missouri. Led by David James. Assess → Simplify → Automate → Train. Humans approve money, access, and deletes.

Henry County Consulting is the consulting front door. It is not AI for Missouri (statewide workshops) and not James Networks (the product lab).
